name: Alok
introEn: Active aura that heals Alok and nearby allies, boosts their movement speed and drops music notes.
introHi: eka Active Aura banaataa hai, jo Alok aur aasapaasa ke teammates ko heal karataa hai, unaki Movement Speed badhaataa hai aur Music Notes giraataa hai.
currentEn: Creates a 5m aura that increases movement speed by 15% and restores 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. While the aura is active, a music note drops 2m behind Alok every 2 seconds and lasts 5 seconds. Teammates who pick up a note gain 15% movement speed and 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. Multiple Drop the Beat auras do not stack.
currentHi: 5m kaa Aura banataa hai, jo 10 seconds taka Movement Speed 15% badhaataa hai aur hara second 5 HP vaapasa detaa hai. Aura active rahane para hara 2 seconds men Alok se 2m pichhe eka Music Note girataa hai, jo 5 seconds taka rahataa hai. Note uthaane vaale teammates ko 10 seconds taka 15% Movement Speed aur 5 HP/s milataa hai. Drop the Beat ke kai Aura eka-dusare ke saatha stack nahin hote.

rows.hi: Music Note girane kaa samaya aur jagah
Music Note kitani dera rahataa hai
Note uthaane para milane vaalaa Bonus

notesEn: While Alok's own skill is active, teammates' Alok auras give no benefit (OB53). Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54). Since OB47 the awakened skill replaces the original for all players; both appearances remain available.
notesHi: Alok ki apani Skill active hone para teammates ke Alok Aura se use koi phaayadaa nahin milataa (OB53). Movement Speed ki eka global maximum limit hai; Skills, items aur events se milane vaale bonuses isa limit ko paara nahin kara sakate (OB54). OB47 se sabhi players ke lie Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagaha le li hai; donon appearances aba bhi available hain.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP recovery 5 to 3 HP/s, cooldown 50s to 45s.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Awakened Alok introduced.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): HP recovery 3 to 5 HP/s, movement speed 15%, duration 10s; music-note pickup healing 3 to 5 HP/s.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill replaced the original for all players.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Fixed skill range not matching the visual range, and speed boost sometimes failing to apply.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Alok users no longer gain from teammates' Alok auras while their own skill is active.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event Skill Boosts: Speed Remix (10m aura, teammates +16% speed) and Heal Remix (20 HP/s while active). Global movement-speed cap added.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP Recovery 5 se ghataakara 3 HP/s aur Cooldown 50s se ghataakara 45s kiyaa gayaa.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Awakened Alok introduce kiyaa gayaa.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): HP Recovery 3 se badhaakara 5 HP/s, Movement Speed 15% aur Duration 10s ki gai; Music Note uthaane para Healing 3 se badhaakara 5 HP/s ki gai.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): sabhi players ke lie Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagaha le li.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Skill ki range aur visual range men antara hone tathaa Speed Boost kabhi-kabhi apply na hone ki samasyaa thika ki gai.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Alok ki apani Skill active hone para use teammates ke Alok Aura se phaayadaa milanaa bnda huaa.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event men Skill Boosts jode gae: Speed Remix (10m Aura, teammates ko +16% Speed) aur Heal Remix (active rahane para 20 HP/s). Global Movement Speed cap jodi gai.

name: A124
introEn: Electromagnetic wave that blocks enemy skills, deals damage and interrupts interactions.
introHi: eka Electromagnetic Wave chhodataa hai, jo Enemy ki Skills block karati hai, Damage deti hai aur unaki chala rahi interactions ko rokati hai.
currentEn: Unleashes an 8m electromagnetic wave. Enemies inside cannot activate skills, take 25 DMG, and have their interaction countdowns (such as reviving) interrupted.
currentHi: 8m ki Electromagnetic Wave chhodataa hai. isake andara maujuda Enemy apani Skills activate nahin kara paaenge, unhen 25 DMG milataa hai aur unaki interactions kaa countdown (jaise revive karanaa) ruka jaataa hai.
notesEn: Skill can be cancelled while aiming. Joseph is immune to A124's interference.
notesHi: Aim karate samaya Skill cancel ki jaa sakati hai. Joseph, A124 ke interference se immune hai.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Reworked into an 8m wave that disables enemy skills.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Added 25 DMG, duration 30s to 20s, cooldown 75s to 50s, cancel while aiming.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Skill ko badalakara 8m ki Wave banaayaa gayaa, jo Enemy ki Skills disable karati hai.
OB42 (Oct 2023): 25 DMG jodaa gayaa; Duration 30s se ghataakara 20s aur Cooldown 75s se ghataakara 50s kiyaa gayaa; Aim karate samaya Skill cancel karane kaa option jodaa gayaa.

name: Andrew
introEn: Passive that slows armor durability loss and adds armor damage reduction, boosted by nearby teammates.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Armor ki Durability kama hone ki Speed ghataati hai aur Armor Damage Reduction deti hai. aasapaasa ke teammates se isakaa bonus badhataa hai.
currentEn: Armor loses durability 40% slower. Wolf Pack adds 4% armor damage reduction, plus 1% for every teammate within 15m.
currentHi: Armor ki Durability 40% dhimi Speed se kama hoti hai. Wolf Pack se 4% Armor Damage Reduction milataa hai, saatha hi 15m ke andara maujuda hara teammate ke lie 1% extra milataa hai.
notesEn: Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs, so Wolf Pack does not reduce damage taken by Shield Points. The OB46 notes do not state whether teammates must also carry Wolf Pack. Since OB47 the awakened skill replaces the original for all players.
notesHi: Shield Points para Armor Damage Reduction ke buffs laagu nahin hote, isalie Wolf Pack Shield Points se hone vaale Damage ko kama nahin karataa. OB46 ke notes men yaha nahin bataayaa gayaa ki teammates ke paasa bhi Wolf Pack honaa jaruri hai yaa nahin. OB47 se sabhi players ke lie Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagaha le li hai.
historyEn: OB40 (Jun 2023): Armor durability loss reduction 20% to 25%.
OB41 (Aug 2023): Armor damage reduction 20% to 15%, teammate bonus 10% to 5%.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Armor durability loss reduction 25% to 40%; armor damage reduction 15% to 5%, +5% per teammate carrying the skill.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Now +4%, +1% per teammate within 15m.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Awakened skill replaced the original for all players.
historyHi: OB40 (Jun 2023): Armor Durability men kami kaa reduction 20% se badhaakara 25% kiyaa gayaa.
OB41 (Aug 2023): Armor Damage Reduction 20% se ghataakara 15% aur Teammate Bonus 10% se ghataakara 5% kiyaa gayaa.

OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Armor Durability men kami kaa reduction 25% se badhaakara 40% kiyaa gayaa; Armor Damage Reduction 15% se ghataakara 5% aur Skill rakhane vaale hara teammate ke lie +5% kiyaa gayaa.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Bonus badalakara +4% aur 15m ke andara hara teammate ke lie +1% kiyaa gayaa.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): sabhi players ke lie Awakened Skill ne original Skill ki jagaha le li.

name: Antonio
introEn: Passive that starts the match with extra Shield Points that recover after combat.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo match ki shuruaata men extra Shield Points deti hai. Combat se bachane ke baada ye Shield Points recover hote hain.
currentEn: Starts the match with 20 extra Shield Points. Shield Points recover after surviving combat.
currentHi: Match ki shuruaata men 20 extra Shield Points milate hain. Combat se bachane ke baada Shield Points recover hote hain.

rows.hi: shuruaata men milane vaale Shield Points

rows.en: Armor damage reduction on Shield Points
rows.hi: Shield Points para Armor Damage Reduction

notesEn: Shield Points are removed before HP. Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs. Shield Points do not protect against Danger Zone, fall or bleeding damage.
notesHi: HP se pahale Shield Points kama hote hain. Shield Points para Armor Damage Reduction ke buffs laagu nahin hote. Shield Points, Danger Zone, girane yaa bleeding se hone vaale Damage se nahin bachaate.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): 40 extra HP converted to 40 Shield Points.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Shield Points recovery speed 10 to 5 SP/s
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): 40 extra HP ko badalakara 40 Shield Points kiyaa gayaa.
OB43 (Jan 2024): 40 se ghataakara 30 kiyaa gayaa.
OB46 (Sep 2024): Shield Points ki Recovery Speed 10 se ghataakara 5 SP/s ki gai.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): 30 se ghataakara 20 kiyaa gayaa.

name: A-Patroa
lastChanged: No balance changes since release (OB34, May 2022)
introEn: Utility character with an exclusive extra skill slot; no personal combat skill.
introHi: eka Utility character, jisake paasa eka exclusive extra Skill Slot hai; isaki apani koi Combat Skill nahin hai.
currentEn: Adds one extra skill slot that can hold any skill owned on the account.
currentHi: eka extra Skill Slot milataa hai, jisamen account para owned koi bhi Skill rakhi jaa sakati hai.
historyEn: OB34 (May 2022): Released.
historyHi: OB34 (May 2022): Release kiyaa gayaa.

name: Paloma
introEn: Passive that boosts weapon accuracy after she destroys a Gloo Wall.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Gloo Wall destroy karane ke baada Weapon Accuracy badhaati hai.
currentEn: Destroying a Gloo Wall increases weapon accuracy for 10 seconds.
currentHi: Gloo Wall destroy karane para 10 seconds ke lie Weapon Accuracy badha jaati hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the accuracy bonus value. Designed to break enemy cover and finish players hiding behind Gloo Walls.
notesHi: Garena, Accuracy Bonus ki exact value publish nahin karataa. yaha Skill Enemy ke cover ko todane aur Gloo Wall ke pichhe chhipe players ko khatma karane ke lie banaai gai hai.
historyEn: OB49 (21 May 2025): Reworked. Her extra-ammo skill was replaced by Shatterburst.
historyHi: OB49 (21 May 2025): Skill ko rework kiyaa gayaa. Extra-ammo Skill ki jagaha Shatterburst ne li.

name: Laura
introEn: Passive that increases accuracy while Laura is scoped in.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Scope men aim karate samaya Accuracy badhaati hai.
currentEn: Accuracy increases by 60% while scoped in.
currentHi: Scope men rahate samaya Accuracy 60% badha jaati hai.
notesEn: Built to help long-range shooters land shots.
notesHi: yaha Skill long-range shooters ko nishaanaa lagaane men madada karane ke lie banaai gai hai.
historyEn: OB28 (Jun 2021): Accuracy bonus raised, maximum 30% to 35%.
OB36 (Sep 2022): Maximum 35% to 50%.
historyHi: OB28 (Jun 2021): Accuracy Bonus ki maximum value 30% se badhaakara 35% ki gai.
OB36 (Sep 2022): Maximum value 35% se badhaakara 50% ki gai.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): 50% se badhaakara 60% ki gai.

name: Rafael
introEn: Passive that silences sniper and marksman fire and speeds up bleeding on knocked-down enemies.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Sniper aur Marksman Rifles ki firing sound ko silent karati hai aur knock hue Enemy ki bleeding Speed badhaati hai.

rows.hi: Knock hue Enemy ki Bleeding Speed

currentEn: With Sniper Rifles and Marksman Rifles, firing sound is silenced and enemies knocked down by Rafael bleed 85% faster.
currentHi: Sniper Rifles aur Marksman Rifles se fire karane para firing sound silent rahati hai. Rafael dvaaraa knock kie gae Enemy ki bleeding Speed 85% badha jaati hai.
notesEn: Works while using Sniper Rifles or Marksman Rifles.
notesHi: yaha Skill Sniper Rifles yaa Marksman Rifles istemaala karate samaya kaama karati hai.
historyEn: OB27 (Apr 2021): Became a passive skill that silences sniper and marksman fire.
OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Limited to Sniper and Marksman Rifles; bleed speed bonus raised, maximum 45% to 90%.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill description corrected to match the actual effect.
historyHi: OB27 (Apr 2021): Passive Skill banaai gai, jo Sniper aur Marksman fire ko silent karati hai.
OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Skill ko Sniper aur Marksman Rifles taka simita kiyaa gayaa; Bleed Speed Bonus ki maximum value 45% se badhaakara 90% ki gai.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill kaa description actual effect ke anusaara thika kiyaa gayaa.
OB40 (Jun 2023): 90% se ghataakara 85% kiyaa gayaa.

name: Jota
introEn: Passive that restores HP when Jota hits and knocks down enemies.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Jota ke Enemy ko hit karane aur knock karane para HP vaapasa deti hai.
currentEn: Hitting an enemy with guns restores some HP. Knocking down an enemy in any way restores 20% HP.
currentHi: Gun se Enemy ko hit karane para kuchha HP vaapasa milati hai. kisi bhi tarike se Enemy ko knock karane para 20% HP vaapasa milati hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the HP restored per gun hit.
Before OB53, only knockdowns scored with guns triggered the recovery.
notesHi: Garena, hara Gun Hit para vaapasa milane vaali HP ki exact value publish nahin karataa.
OB53 se pahale Recovery sirpha Gun se kie gae Knockdown para trigger hoti thi.
historyEn: Before OB29: SMG or Shotgun kills restored HP, 5-second cooldown.
OB29 (Aug 2021): Reworked so gun hits restore HP and knockdowns restore up to 20% max HP.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Any type of knockdown now triggers the recovery.
historyHi: OB29 se pahale: SMG yaa Shotgun se kill karane para HP vaapasa milati thi aur 5-second Cooldown thaa.
OB29 (Aug 2021): Skill ko rework kiyaa gayaa, taaki Gun Hits para HP vaapasa mile aur Knockdown para maximum HP kaa 20% taka recover ho.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): aba kisi bhi taraha kaa Knockdown Recovery trigger karataa hai.

name: Clu
introEn: Active scan that reveals enemy positions and shares them with the squad.
introHi: eka Active Scan, jo Enemy ki positions dikhaataa hai aur unhen Squad ke saatha share karataa hai.
currentEn: Locates enemies within 80m who are not prone or crouching for 10 seconds. Enemy positions are shared with teammates.
currentHi: 10 seconds taka 80m ke andara maujuda una Enemy ki location pataa chalati hai jo prone yaa crouch nahin kara rahe hote. Enemy ki positions teammates ke saatha share hoti hain.
notesEn: Prone or crouching enemies are not revealed.
Scanned enemies get a notification on their minimap and screen.
notesHi: Prone yaa crouch kara rahe Enemy reveal nahin hote.
Scan hue Enemy ko unake Minimap aur screen para notification milataa hai.
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): Duration 5-7.5s to 5-10s, cooldown 75-60s to 75-50s by level.
OB37 (Nov 2022): Maximum scan range 75m to 65m.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Cooldown 50s to 45s; scanned enemies now get a notification.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Scan range 65m to 80m.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Level ke hisaaba se Duration 5–7.5s se badhaakara 5–10s aur Cooldown 75–60s se ghataakara 75–50s kiyaa gayaa.
OB37 (Nov 2022): Maximum Scan Range 75m se ghataakara 65m ki gai.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Cooldown 50s se ghataakara 45s kiyaa gayaa; Scan hue Enemy ko notification milane lagaa.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Scan Range 65m se badhaakara 80m ki gai.

name: Wolfrahh
introEn: Passive that grows with every elimination: tougher against headshots and stronger headshots.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo hara Elimination ke saatha majabuta hoti hai: Headshot se bachaava badhataa hai aur Headshot Damage bhi badhataa hai.
currentEn: Every elimination adds one spectator, and spectators never decrease. Each spectator reduces headshot damage taken by 4% and increases headshot damage dealt by 10%.
currentHi: hara Elimination para 1 Spectator judataa hai aur Spectators kama nahin hote. hara Spectator se liyaa gayaa Headshot Damage 4% kama aur diyaa gayaa Headshot Damage 10% badha jaataa hai.
notesEn: Maximum effect is reached at 3 spectators.
notesHi: Maximum Effect 3 Spectators para milataa hai.
historyEn: OB22 (May 2020): Introduced.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Spectators required reduced from 6 to 3; limb damage bonus replaced with headshot damage bonus.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Headshot damage taken reduction 7% to 4% per spectator, maximum 21% to 12%.
historyHi: OB22 (May 2020): Introduce kiyaa gayaa.
OB34 (25 May 2022): jaruri Spectators 6 se ghataakara 3 kie gae; Limb Damage Bonus ki jagaha Headshot Damage Bonus diyaa gayaa.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): hara Spectator para lie gae Headshot Damage men kami 7% se ghataakara 4% aur maximum kami 21% se ghataakara 12% ki gai.

name: Jai
introEn: Passive that refills Jai's magazine after a knockdown or an active skill.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Knockdown karane yaa Active Skill istemaala karane ke baada Jai ki Magazine refill karati hai.

rows.value: Knocking down an enemy or using an active skill
Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns, Sniper Rifles

currentEn: After knocking down an enemy or using an active skill, the gun's magazine reloads automatically to 100% of its maximum capacity.
currentHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karane yaa Active Skill istemaala karane ke baada Gun ki Magazine apane aapa usaki maximum capacity ke 100% taka refill ho jaati hai.
notesEn: Works with Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns and Sniper Rifles. The active-skill trigger leaves Jai with a loaded weapon right after using a skill.
notesHi: Assault Rifles, Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns aur Sniper Rifles ke saatha kaama karati hai. Active Skill istemaala karane ke turnta baada Jai ki Gun loaded rahati hai.
historyEn: Sep 2020 (Booyah Day): Reload capacity maximum 25% to 45%; Shotguns added.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked. Magazine now refills after a knockdown or an active skill, to 100% for all weapon types including Sniper Rifles.
historyHi: Sep 2020 (Booyah Day): Maximum Reload Capacity 25% se badhaakara 45% ki gai; Shotguns jodi gain.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Skill ko rework kiyaa gayaa. aba Knockdown yaa Active Skill ke baada Magazine sabhi weapon types ke lie 100% taka refill hoti hai, jisamen Sniper Rifles bhi shaamila hain.

name: Alvaro
introEn: Passive that boosts explosive damage and range, and splits each grenade into mini grenades after it explodes.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Explosive Damage aur Range badhaati hai. Grenade explode hone ke baada chhote Mini Grenades men bnta jaataa hai.
currentEn: Explosive weapon damage increases by 20% and range increases by 10%. Each grenade splits into 3 mini grenades after exploding, dealing 20% of the original grenade's damage.
currentHi: Explosive Weapon Damage 20% aur Range 10% badha jaati hai. hara Grenade explode hone ke baada 3 Mini Grenades men bnta jaataa hai, jo original Grenade ke Damage kaa 20% dete hain.
notesEn: Grenades split only after exploding, so grenade cooking is no longer disrupted (OB47). Since OB47 this skill replaces Art of Demolition for all players.
notesHi: Grenade aba sirpha explode hone ke baada split hote hain, isalie Grenade cook karane ki prakriyaa baadhita nahin hoti (OB47). OB47 se sabhi players ke lie isa Skill ne Art of Demolition ki jagaha le li hai.
historyEn: OB29 (Aug 2021): Art of Demolition damage bonus raised, maximum 16% to 20%.
OB39 (Mar 2023): Awakened Alvaro "Rageblast" introduced with Split Blitz: +20% damage, +10% range, grenades split into 3 extra grenades 1 second before detonating at 30% damage.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Split Blitz replaced Art of Demolition for all players; grenades now split after exploding, mini grenades deal 20%.
historyHi: OB29 (Aug 2021): Art of Demolition kaa Damage Bonus maximum 16% se badhaakara 20% kiyaa gayaa.

OB39 (Mar 2023): Awakened Alvaro "Rageblast" ko Split Blitz ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa: +20% Damage, +10% Range; Grenades phatane se 1 second pahale 3 extra Grenades men bntate the, jo 30% Damage dete the.
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): sabhi players ke lie Split Blitz ne Art of Demolition ki jagaha li; Grenades aba explode hone ke baada split hote hain aur Mini Grenades 20% Damage dete hain.

name: Miguel
introEn: Passive that restores EP for every enemy Miguel knocks down.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Miguel ke hara Knockdown para EP vaapasa deti hai.
currentEn: Gains 200 EP for each knockdown.
currentHi: hara Knockdown para 200 EP milate hain.
notesEn: Triggers on knockdowns, not eliminations. Can be paired with other recovery skills.
notesHi: yaha Skill Knockdown para trigger hoti hai, Elimination para nahin. ise dusari Recovery Skills ke saatha use kiyaa jaa sakataa hai.
historyEn: OB35 (Aug 2022): Crazy Slayer now triggers on knockdowns instead of eliminations, 30-80 EP by level.
OB36 (Sep 2022): EP per knockdown 30-80 to 100-200.
historyHi: OB35 (Aug 2022): Crazy Slayer aba Elimination ki jagaha Knockdown para trigger hoti hai; Level ke hisaaba se 30–80 EP milate hain.
OB36 (Sep 2022): hara Knockdown para EP 30–80 se badhaakara 100–200 kie gae.

name: Nikita
introEn: Passive that speeds up reloads and reduces enemy healing on every hit.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Reload Speed badhaati hai aur hara Hit para Enemy ki Healing kama karati hai.

rows.hi: Hit hue Target ki Healing men kami

currentEn: Reload speed increases by 20%. Every time Nikita hits an enemy, that target gets a 50% healing reduction for 6 seconds (maximum 50%).
currentHi: Reload Speed 20% badha jaati hai. Nikita jaba bhi kisi Enemy ko hit karati hai, usa target ki Healing 6 seconds ke lie 50% kama ho jaati hai (maximum 50%).
notesEn: Built to counter high-healing characters such as Ford and Kassie. Hits do not stack the reduction beyond the 50% maximum. A visual indicator now shows when you apply Healing Reduction on an enemy (OB54).
notesHi: yaha Ford aur Kassie jaise jyaadaa Healing dene vaale characters ko counter karane ke lie upayogi hai. Hits se Healing Reduction 50% ki maximum limit se aage stack nahin hoti. OB54 men aba Enemy para Healing Reduction apply hone para visual indicator dikhataa hai.
historyEn: OB37 (Nov 2022): Reload speed 14-24% to a flat 20%.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked: reload speed +20%, 30% healing reduction for 10s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Healing reduction 30% to 50%, duration 10s to 6s; reload speed 30%.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Reload speed 30% to 20%.
historyHi: OB37 (Nov 2022): Reload Speed 14–24% se badalakara fixed 20% ki gai.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Rework kiyaa gayaa: +20% Reload Speed aur 10s ke lie 30% Healing Reduction.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Healing Reduction 30% se badhaakara 50%, Duration 10s se ghataakara 6s; Reload Speed 30% ki gai.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Reload Speed 30% se ghataakara 20% ki gai.

name: Kapella
introEn: Passive that lets any weapon heal teammates and boosts Heal Pistol healing.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jisase kisi bhi Weapon se teammates ko heal kiyaa jaa sakataa hai aur Heal Pistol ki Healing bhi badhati hai.
currentEn: Shooting teammates with any weapon heals them for 20% of the damage dealt. Heal Pistols have a 20% higher healing effect.
currentHi: kisi bhi Weapon se teammate ko shoot karane para die gae Damage kaa 20% use heal karataa hai. Heal Pistols ki Healing Effect 20% badha jaati hai.
notesEn: Pairs with the Heal Pistol-Y, which helps up downed teammates by shooting them (OB49).
notesHi: yaha Heal Pistol-Y ke saatha kaama karati hai, jisase down hue teammates ko shoot karake help up kiyaa jaa sakataa hai (OB49).
historyEn: OB21 (Apr 2020): Introduced with Healing Song.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Healing Song reworked: 80 HP shield and 10% speed boost on help-up, downed teammates bleed 35% slower.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Help-up speed boost 10% to 80%.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Reworked into Remedy Rounds.
historyHi: OB21 (Apr 2020): Healing Song ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Healing Song rework hui: Help-up para 80 HP Shield aur 10% Speed Boost; down hue teammates ki Bleeding Speed 35% kam.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Help-up Speed Boost 10% se badhaakara 80% kiyaa gayaa.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Skill ko Remedy Rounds men rework kiyaa gayaa.

name: Joseph
introEn: Passive that grants immunity to disruptive effects and a short movement-speed boost.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo pareshaana karane vaale effects se immunity aur thode samaya ke lie Movement Speed Boost deti hai.
currentEn: Become immune to disruptive effects (slowdown, marking, skill-silencing) and gain a 10% movement-speed boost for 5 seconds.
currentHi: Slowdown, marking aur Skill-silencing jaise disruptive effects se immunity milati hai aur 5 seconds ke lie Movement Speed 10% badha jaati hai.
notesEn: Immune to Moco's marking, Homer's drone and A124's nano interference. Garena does not publish the exact trigger condition. Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54).
notesHi: Moco ki Marking, Homer ki Drone aur A124 ke Nano Interference se immunity milati hai. Garena exact Trigger Condition publish nahin karataa. Movement Speed ki eka global maximum limit hai; Skills, items aur events ke bonuses isa limit ko paara nahin kara sakate (OB54).
historyEn: OB35 (Jul 2022): Original skill Nutty Movement had its speed boost lowered.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Reworked into Silver Spoon: immunity and 10% speed for 5s, cooldown 60s.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Cooldown 60s to 45s.
historyHi: OB35 (Jul 2022): Original Skill Nutty Movement kaa Speed Boost kama kiyaa gayaa.
OB42 (Oct 2023): Silver Spoon men rework kiyaa gayaa: 5s ke lie immunity aur 10% Speed; Cooldown 60s.
OB44 (Apr 2024): Cooldown 60s se ghataakara 45s kiyaa gayaa.

name: Wukong
introEn: Active skill that turns Wukong into a bush for ambushes and repositioning.
introHi: eka Active Skill, jo Wukong ko Bush men badala deti hai taaki vaha Ambush kara sake aur apani Position badala sake.
currentEn: Transforms into a bush with a 10% reduction in movement speed for 10 seconds. The transformation ends when Wukong attacks. The cooldown resets if Wukong takes down an enemy within 10 seconds after releasing the skill.
currentHi: Wukong 10 seconds ke lie Bush men badala jaataa hai aur usaki Movement Speed 10% kama ho jaati hai. Wukong ke Attack karate hi Transformation khatma ho jaataa hai. Skill istemaala karane ke 10 seconds ke andara Wukong kisi Enemy ko knock karataa hai, to Cooldown reset ho jaataa hai.

OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Cooldown 90s se ghataakara 75s kiyaa gayaa.

name: Olivia
introEn: Passive that boosts healing and shares single-target healing with nearby teammates.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Healing badhaati hai aur eka target ko milane vaali Healing kaa hissaa aasapaasa ke teammates men baantati hai.
currentEn: Increases healing effects by 30% and spreads 90% of the user's single-target healing amount to teammates within 20m.
currentHi: Healing Effects 30% badha jaate hain aur user ko milane vaali single-target Healing kaa 90% hissaa 20m ke andara teammates men share hotaa hai.
notesEn: Built as a team healer to support nearby teammates.
notesHi: yaha Skill aasapaasa ke teammates ko support karane vaale team healer ke taura para banaai gai hai.
historyEn: OB27 (Apr 2021): Revive bonus HP raised, maximum 40 to 70.
Jan 2022 (Illuminate): Revive bonus HP maximum 70 to 80.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Reworked: spreads 80% of single-target healing to teammates within 10m; revive role passed to Thiva.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Added +30% healing effects; spread range 10m to 15m.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Shared healing 80% to 90%, range 15m to 20m.
historyHi: OB27 (Apr 2021): Revive Bonus HP ki maximum value 40 se badhaakara 70 ki gai.
Jan 2022 (Illuminate): Revive Bonus HP ki maximum value 70 se badhaakara 80 ki gai.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Rework kiyaa gayaa: single-target Healing kaa 80% hissaa 10m ke andara teammates men share hone lagaa; Revive ki bhumikaa Thiva ko di gai.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): +30% Healing Effects jode gae; Share Range 10m se badhaakara 15m ki gai.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Shared Healing 80% se badhaakara 90% aur Range 15m se badhaakara 20m ki gai.

name: Shani
introEn: Passive that gives Shield Points to Shani and nearby teammates whenever she uses an active skill.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Shani ke Active Skill istemaala karane para use aur aasapaasa ke teammates ko Shield Points deti hai.
currentEn: When using an active skill, gives 30 Shield Points to self and teammates within 10m. The Shield Points decay after 10 seconds, after which players can obtain the effect again.
currentHi: Active Skill istemaala karane para Shani aur 10m ke andara maujuda teammates ko 30 Shield Points milate hain. ye Shield Points 10 seconds baada dhire-dhire khatma ho jaate hain; isake baada players dobaaraa yaha Effect paa sakate hain.
notesEn: Shield Points are deducted before HP. Shield Points ignore armor damage-reduction buffs. Shield Points do not protect against Danger Zone, fall or bleeding damage.
notesHi: HP se pahale Shield Points kama hote hain. Shield Points para Armor Damage Reduction ke buffs laagu nahin hote. Shield Points, Danger Zone, girane yaa bleeding se hone vaale Damage se nahin bachaate.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): Reworked: 50 Shield Points, decay after 5s, cooldown 10s.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): 50 to 40 Shield Points.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): 40 to 30 Shield Points.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Decay time 5s to 10s.
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): Rework kiyaa gayaa: 50 Shield Points, 5s baada khatma hote the aur Cooldown 10s thaa.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Shield Points 50 se ghataakara 40 kie gae.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Shield Points 40 se ghataakara 30 kie gae.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Shield khatma hone kaa samaya 5s se badhaakara 10s kiyaa gayaa.

name: Ford
introEn: Passive that restores HP over time after Ford takes damage.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Ford ko Damage lagane ke baada samaya ke saatha HP vaapasa deti hai.
currentEn: Gains 10 HP/s for 3 seconds when taking damage. The skill resets immediately after Ford releases an active skill.
currentHi: Damage lagane para 3 seconds taka hara second 10 HP milati hai. Ford ke Active Skill chhodate hi Skill turnta reset ho jaati hai.
notesEn: Cooldown 20 seconds between triggers.
notesHi: hara Trigger ke bicha 20 seconds kaa Cooldown hotaa hai.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): Reworked to restore HP when taking damage, 10 HP/s for 3s, cooldown 20s; Danger Zone survivability reduced.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Duration 3s to 4s.
OB51 (Oct 2025): Duration 4s to 3s.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Damage lagane para 3s taka 10 HP/s Recovery aur 20s Cooldown ke saatha Skill ko rework kiyaa gayaa; Danger Zone men Survivability kama ki gai.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Duration 3s se badhaakara 4s ki gai.
OB51 (Oct 2025): Duration 4s se ghataakara 3s ki gai.

name: K
introEn: Active skill that switches between EP-conversion support and personal EP recovery modes.
introHi: eka Active Skill, jo EP-conversion support aur khuda EP recover karane vaale modes ke bicha switch karati hai.
currentEn: Master of All increases Max EP by 50. Jiu-jitsu Mode boosts EP conversion for allies within 15m by 600%. Psychology Mode restores 3 EP every 1s, up to 250 EP.
currentHi: Master of All se Max EP 50 badhataa hai. Jiu-jitsu Mode men 15m ke andara allies kaa EP Conversion 600% badha jaataa hai. Psychology Mode men hara 1s para 3 EP vaapasa milate hain, maximum 250 EP tak.
notesEn: Garena does not publish a separate numeric EP-conversion rate beyond the stated 600% increase.
notesHi: Garena, bataae gae 600% increase ke alaavaa EP-conversion rate ki koi alaga numeric value publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: OB46 (4 Sep 2024): Jiu-jitsu ally range 6m → 15m; Psychology recovery interval 2s → 1s; mode-switch cooldown 3s → 6s. Max EP 50; conversion boost 600%; recovery cap 250 EP.
historyHi: OB46 (4 Sep 2024): Jiu-jitsu Ally Range 6m se badhaakara 15m; Psychology Recovery Interval 2s se ghataakara 1s; Mode-switch Cooldown 3s se badhaakara 6s kiyaa gayaa. Max EP 50, Conversion Boost 600% aur Recovery Limit 250 EP rakhi gai.

name: Sonia
introEn: Passive survival skill that briefly protects Sonia after fatal damage, then requires a knockdown before its shield expires.
introHi: eka Passive Survival Skill, jo fatal Damage lagane ke baada Sonia ko thodi dera bachaati hai. isake baada Shield khatma hone se pahale Knockdown karanaa jaruri hotaa hai.
currentEn: After fatal damage, Sonia enters an invulnerable and immobile state for 0.4s, then gains a 1 HP shield for 2s. Sonia is eliminated when the shield disappears.
currentHi: Fatal Damage lagane ke baada Sonia 0.4s ke lie invulnerable aur immobile state men chali jaati hai, phira use 2s ke lie 1 HP Shield milataa hai. Shield khatma hote hi Sonia eliminate ho jaati hai.
notesEn: The OB50 notes specify elimination when the shield disappears; no successful knockdown rescue condition remains in the current profile. Garena does not publish a different outcome if the shield is depleted early.
notesHi: OB50 ke notes ke mutaabika Shield khatma hone para Sonia eliminate ho jaati hai; current profile men Knockdown karake bachane ki condition nahin hai. Shield samaya se pahale puri taraha khatma ho jaae to kyaa hotaa hai, isaki alaga jaanakaari Garena publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Shield reduced 150 HP → 100 HP.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Revival feature removed; 0.5s → 0.4s invulnerability and shield duration 3s → 2s; shield 100 HP → 50 HP.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Shield 50 HP → 1 HP; user is eliminated when shield disappears.
historyHi: OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Shield 150 HP se ghataakara 100 HP kiyaa gayaa.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Revival Feature hataayaa gayaa; Invulnerability 0.5s se ghataakara 0.4s aur Shield Duration 3s se ghataakara 2s ki gai; Shield 100 HP se ghataakara 50 HP kiyaa gayaa.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Shield 50 HP se ghataakara 1 HP kiyaa gayaa; Shield khatma hone para user eliminate ho jaataa hai.

name: Orion
introEn: Active defensive skill that consumes Crimson Energy to grant temporary protection and drain nearby enemies' HP.
introHi: eka Active Defensive Skill, jo Crimson Energy kharcha karake thode samaya ki Protection deti hai aur aasapaasa ke Enemy ki HP absorb karati hai.
currentEn: Replaces EP with 300 Crimson Energy. Consumes 200 energy to activate protection for 3s; Orion cannot take damage or attack and absorbs 10 HP (ignoring enemy Shield Points) from enemies within 5m. Movement speed is reduced by 10%. Cooldown: 3s.
currentHi: EP ki jagaha 300 Crimson Energy milati hai. Protection activate karane ke lie 200 Energy kharcha hoti hai aur yaha 3s taka rahati hai; isa dauraana Orion ko Damage nahin lagataa aur vaha Attack nahin kara sakataa. 5m ke andara maujuda Enemy se 10 HP absorb hoti hai (Enemy ke Shield Points ko ignore karake). Movement Speed 10% kama ho jaati hai. Cooldown: 3s.
notesEn: Protection prevents damage and attacking while active. HP absorption ignores enemy Shield Points.
notesHi: Protection active rahane para Damage nahin lagataa aur Attack nahin kara sakate. HP Absorption Enemy ke Shield Points ko ignore karati hai.
historyEn: OB46 (4 Sep 2024): Movement-speed penalty reduced 20% → 10%.
historyHi: OB46 (4 Sep 2024): Movement Speed Penalty 20% se ghataakara 10% ki gai.

name: Santino
introEn: Active mobility skill that deploys a moving mannequin and allows limited position swaps with it.
introHi: eka Active Mobility Skill, jo eka moving Mannequin deploy karati hai aur usake saatha simita baara Position Swap karane deti hai.
currentEn: Spawns a 200 HP mannequin that moves autonomously for 25s. When within 90m, use the skill again to swap positions; up to 2 swaps, with only one swap allowed within 3s. The player who destroys the mannequin is marked for 5s. Teleport is prohibited if mannequin is 10m higher than Santino. Cooldown: 60s.
currentHi: 200 HP vaalaa Mannequin spawn hotaa hai, jo 25s taka apane aapa move karataa hai. 90m ke andara rahate hue Skill dobaaraa istemaala karake Position Swap kara sakate hain; maximum 2 swaps, aur hara 3s men sirpha 1 swap allowed hai. Mannequin destroy karane vaalaa player 5s ke lie mark ho jaataa hai. agara Mannequin, Santino se 10m jyaadaa unchaai para hai to Teleport nahin kara sakate. Cooldown: 60s.

rows.value: No teleport if mannequin is 10m higher

notesEn: OB50 added the 10m vertical restriction. Garena does not publish a separate exact movement speed for the mannequin.
notesHi: OB50 men 10m ki vertical restriction jodi gai. Mannequin ki exact Movement Speed Garena publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): Mannequin changed from stationary to autonomous movement; cooldown 80s.
OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Mannequin duration 12s → 25s; cooldown 75s → 60s; swap limit set to 2 and 3s spacing; mark destroyer for 5s.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Mannequin range 60m → 90m; vertical restriction added (no teleport if mannequin is 10m higher).
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Fixed a small mannequin collision volume that could let players enter unintended areas, get stuck, or exploit glitches (bug fix; no skill stat changed).
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Mannequin ko stationary se autonomous movement men badalaa gayaa; Cooldown 80s kiyaa gayaa.

OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Mannequin Duration 12s se badhaakara 25s; Cooldown 75s se ghataakara 60s; Swap Limit 2 aur swaps ke bicha 3s kaa gap kiyaa gayaa; Mannequin destroy karane vaale ko 5s ke lie mark kiyaa gayaa.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Mannequin Range 60m se badhaakara 90m ki gai; vertical restriction jodi gai (Mannequin 10m unchaa hone para Teleport nahin kara sakate).

OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Mannequin ke collision volume ki chhoti samasyaa thika ki gai, jisase players anachaahi jagahon men jaa sakate the, phnsa sakate the yaa glitches kaa phaayadaa uthaa sakate the (bug fix; Skill ke stats nahin badale).

name: Tatsuya
introEn: Active mobility skill that dashes forward and refreshes its cooldown after a timely knockdown.
introHi: eka Active Mobility Skill, jo aage ki tarapha Dash karati hai aur sahi samaya para Knockdown karane para apanaa Cooldown reset kara deti hai.
currentEn: Rushes forward quickly for 0.3s. Knocking down an enemy within 10s after skill release resets Rebel Rush's cooldown. If no qualifying knockdown occurs, cooldown is 90s.
currentHi: 0.3s ke lie teji se aage Dash karataa hai. Skill chhodane ke 10s ke andara kisi Enemy ko Knockdown karane para Rebel Rush kaa Cooldown reset ho jaataa hai. agara isa samaya men Knockdown nahin hotaa, to Cooldown 90s rahataa hai.
notesEn: Cooldown reset is conditional, not an automatic reset on every knockdown: the knockdown must occur within 10s after releasing the skill. Garena does not publish a limit on repeated qualifying resets during a match.
notesHi: Cooldown Reset hara Knockdown para apane aapa nahin hotaa. Knockdown, Skill chhodane ke 10s ke andara honaa chaahie. eka match men kitani baara yaha reset ho sakataa hai, isaki limit Garena publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: OB43 (19 Feb 2024): Stored charges 3 → 2 (older mechanic).
OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Dash replenishment 45s → 60s (older mechanic).
OB47 (2 Dec 2024): Cooldown between uses 1s → 5s (older mechanic).
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Reset changed from any knockdown to a knockdown within 10s after skill release; base cooldown 120s → 90s.
historyHi: OB43 (19 Feb 2024): Stored Charges 3 se ghataakara 2 kie gae (puraanaa mechanic).
OB44 (16 Apr 2024): Dash Replenishment 45s se badhaakara 60s kiyaa gayaa (puraanaa mechanic).

name: Luna
introEn: Passive that boosts rate of fire and converts part of it into movement speed after Luna lands a hit.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Rate of Fire badhaati hai aur Luna ke Hit lagaane ke baada usake eka hisse ko Movement Speed men badala deti hai.
currentEn: Increases rate of fire by 5%. When Luna hits an enemy, up to 10% of her rate of fire converts into movement speed. The conversion resets when she survives combat.
currentHi: Rate of Fire 5% badha jaati hai. Luna jaba kisi Enemy ko hit karati hai, to usake Rate of Fire kaa maximum 10% hissaa Movement Speed men convert ho jaataa hai. Combat se bachane para yaha conversion reset ho jaataa hai.

rows.value: Up to 10% of rate of fire
Landing a hit on an enemy

notesEn: Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54).
notesHi: Movement Speed ki eka global maximum limit hai; Skills, items aur events ke bonuses isa limit ko paara nahin kara sakate (OB54).
historyEn: OB36 (Sep 2022): Introduced.
Before OB49: rate of fire +8%, up to 15% converted to movement speed.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum conversion 15% to 10%.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Rate of fire bonus 8% to 5%.
historyHi: OB36 (Sep 2022): Introduce kiyaa gayaa.
OB49 se pahale: Rate of Fire +8%, aur maximum 15% Movement Speed men convert hoti thi.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum Conversion 15% se ghataakara 10% ki gai.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Rate of Fire Bonus 8% se ghataakara 5% kiyaa gayaa.

name: Iris
introEn: Active skill that marks enemies behind Gloo Walls and lets Iris damage them through the walls.
introHi: eka Active Skill, jo Gloo Walls ke pichhe maujuda Enemy ko mark karati hai aur Iris ko divaara ke paara se unhen Damage karane deti hai.
currentEn: For 15 seconds, successfully firing at a Gloo Wall marks enemies within 7m of it and penetrates the Gloo Wall to damage the marked enemies, with lower damage than usual. Works on up to 3 Gloo Walls.
currentHi: 15 seconds taka Gloo Wall para saphalataapurvaka fire karane se usake 7m ke andara maujuda Enemy mark ho jaate hain. isake baada Gloo Wall ke paara se mark hue Enemy ko Damage kiyaa jaa sakataa hai, lekina Damage saamaanya se kama hotaa hai. yaha Skill maximum 3 Gloo Walls para kaama karati hai.
notesEn: Garena does not publish the reduced damage value.
Attacks that penetrate Gloo Walls, like Iris's skill, show a clearer hit effect on the walls (OB49).
notesHi: Garena, kama hue Damage ki exact value publish nahin karataa.
Iris ki Skill jaisi Gloo Wall ke paara jaane vaali attacks para divaara para jyaadaa saapha Hit Effect dikhataa hai (OB49).
historyEn: OB35 (2022): Introduced.
OB38 (Jan 2023): Skill duration increased.
OB40 (Jun 2023): Gloo Walls affected 5 to 3.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): Fixed a damage bug when the skill penetrates Gloo Walls.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Clearer visual effect when hitting Gloo Walls.
historyHi: OB35 (2022): Introduce kiyaa gayaa.
OB38 (Jan 2023): Skill Duration badhaai gai.
OB40 (Jun 2023): prabhaavita Gloo Walls 5 se ghataakara 3 ki gain.
OB43 (24 Jan 2024): Skill ke Gloo Walls ke paara jaane para Damage se judaa bug thika kiyaa gayaa.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Gloo Walls para Hit hone kaa Visual Effect jyaadaa saapha kiyaa gayaa.

name: J.Biebs
introEn: Passive that lets J.Biebs and nearby allies block damage using EP, with allies' EP flowing to J.Biebs.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jisase J.Biebs aur aasapaasa ke allies EP kaa istemaala karake Damage block kara sakate hain. Allies kaa kharcha huaa EP J.Biebs ko milataa hai.
currentEn: J.Biebs and allies within 15m can block 8% of damage using EP. The EP deducted from allies is added to J.Biebs's EP.
currentHi: J.Biebs aur 15m ke andara maujuda allies EP kaa istemaala karake 8% Damage block kara sakate hain. Allies se ghataayaa gayaa EP, J.Biebs ke EP men juda jaataa hai.

rows.hi: EP se Block hone vaalaa Damage

rows.value: Allies' deducted EP is added to J.Biebs's EP

notesEn: The 15m range matches the support range of K and Olivia (OB46).
notesHi: 15m ki Range, K aur Olivia ki Support Range ke baraabara hai (OB46).
historyEn: OB38 (Jan 2023): Range fixed at 12m for all ranks (previously 6m to 12m); maximum damage block 15% to 12%.
OB45 (Jun 2024): Range 12m to 15m; damage blocked 12% to 8%.
historyHi: OB38 (Jan 2023): sabhi ranks ke lie Range 12m taya ki gai (pahale 6m se 12m taka); Maximum Damage Block 15% se ghataakara 12% kiyaa gayaa.
OB45 (Jun 2024): Range 12m se badhaakara 15m; Damage Block 12% se ghataakara 8% kiyaa gayaa.

name: Homer
introEn: Active drone that locks onto the nearest enemy and slows them with a pulse explosion.
introHi: eka Active Drone, jo sabase najadiki Enemy ko lock karati hai aur Pulse Explosion se usaki Speed kama karati hai.
currentEn: Releases a drone toward the nearest enemy within 100m in front. It creates a 5m-diameter pulse explosion that reduces enemies' movement speed by 40% and rate of fire by 40% for 5 seconds, and deals 25 DMG.
currentHi: saamane 100m ke andara maujuda sabase najadiki Enemy ki tarapha Drone bhejataa hai. yaha 5m diameter kaa Pulse Explosion banaati hai, jo 5 seconds ke lie Enemy ki Movement Speed 40% aur Rate of Fire 40% kama karataa hai, saatha hi 25 DMG detaa hai.
notesEn: The drone triggers Moco's tagging skill (OB40).
Once the drone locks a target, obstacles do not block it (OB43).
Joseph is immune to Homer's drone (OB42).
A voice notification plays when no enemy is detected (OB49).
notesHi: yaha Drone Moco ki Tagging Skill ko trigger karati hai (OB40).
Drone kisi target ko lock kara le, to obstacles use roka nahin paate (OB43).
Joseph, Homer ki Drone se immune hai (OB42).
koi Enemy detect na hone para Voice Notification sunaai detaa hai (OB49).

historyHi: OB40 (Jun 2023): Explosion Diameter 5m se ghataakara 3m kiyaa gayaa; Drone aba Moco ki Tagging Skill trigger karati hai.

name: Kenta
introEn: Active skill that sends a tempest through Gloo Walls, then teleports Kenta to it with a short shield.

currentEn: Unleashes a fast-moving, swirling tempest that passes through Gloo Walls and lasts 8 seconds, dealing 25 DMG to enemies hit. currentHi: teji se ghumati hui Tempest chhodataa hai, jo Gloo Walls ke paara jaati hai aur 8 seconds taka rahati hai. isaki chapeta men aane vaale Enemy ko 25 DMG milataa hai. Tempest active rahate hue Skill dobaaraa tap karane para Kenta usaki location para Teleport ho jaataa hai aur 5 seconds ke lie 20% Damage Reduction vaalaa Shield paataa hai. Teleport ke baada Tempest gaayaba ho jaati hai.

name: Nairi
introEn: Passive ability that restores deployed Gloo Wall durability and provides limited HP recovery to nearby teammates.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo lagaai gai Gloo Wall ki Durability vaapasa badhaati hai aur aasapaasa ke teammates ko thodi HP Recovery deti hai.

Teammates within 5m recover 5 HP per second during the effect window.
currentHi: Gloo Wall lagaane ke baada 1.5-second Effect Window ke dauraana usaki Durability hara second 160 badhati hai.
isa Effect Window ke dauraana 5m ke andara maujuda teammates hara second 5 HP recover karate hain.

rows.hi: Deploy karane ke baada Effect Window
paasa ke Teammates ki HP Recovery

Garena does not publish a current maximum HP recovery total per teammate per Gloo Wall.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: kai Gloo Walls lagaane se Teammate Healing Effect stack nahin hotaa.
OB42 men hara Gloo Wall se hara teammate ko maximum 40 HP milane ki baata kahi gai thi; baada ke Patch Notes yaha confirm nahin karate ki yaha cap aba bhi laagu hai yaa nahin.
Garena, hara teammate ko eka Gloo Wall se milane vaali current maximum HP Recovery publish nahin karataa.
Garena isa Passive Ability kaa numeric Cooldown publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: OB36 (21 Sep 2022): Gloo Wall durability restoration increased from 20/22/24/26/28/30% to 40/42/44/46/48/50% of current durability every 1s.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Ice Iron documented as restoring 250 durability/s to deployed Gloo Walls when hit; teammates within 5m recovered 20 HP/s, with a 40 HP per-teammate cap per wall.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Gloo Wall durability restoration reduced from 250 to 150 per second.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Durability restoration increased from 150 to 160 per second; teammate recovery changed from 20 to 10 HP/s, within 3s after deployment.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): The post-deployment effect window changed from 3s to 2s.
OB50 (30 Jul 2025): The effect window changed from 2s to 1.5s and teammate recovery changed from 10 to 5 HP/s.
historyHi: OB36 (21 Sep 2022): Gloo Wall Durability Recovery ko hara 1s men current Durability ke 20/22/24/26/28/30% se badhaakara 40/42/44/46/48/50% kiyaa gayaa.

OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Ice Iron men darja kiyaa gayaa ki Hit hone para deployed Gloo Walls 250 Durability/s recover karati hain; 5m ke andara teammates 20 HP/s recover karate the, hara teammate ke lie hara wall para 40 HP cap ke saath.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Gloo Wall Durability Recovery 250 se ghataakara 150 per second ki gai.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Durability Recovery 150 se badhaakara 160 per second ki gai; Teammate Recovery 20 se ghataakara 10 HP/s aur deployment ke baada 3s taka ki gai.

OB50 (30 Jul 2025): Effect Window 2s se ghataakara 1.5s aur Teammate Recovery 10 se ghataakara 5 HP/s ki gai.

source.label: Garena — Official Nairi full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: For a planned hold or rotation, deploy the Gloo Wall at the cover point your squad intends to use so its short restoration window begins while the team stabilizes.
Keep teammates within 5m during the brief HP-recovery window; call the regroup before spreading into separate angles.
Treat Ice Iron as a short support window, not sustained healing. Time the wall deployment around the squad's move rather than relying on repeated walls to stack recovery.
tacticalHi: Squad ko kisi jagaha hold yaa rotate karanaa ho, to Gloo Wall usi cover point para lagaaen jahaan team rukane vaali hai, taaki team ke settle hote samaya usaki chhoti Recovery Window shuru ho.
HP Recovery ki chhoti Window ke dauraana teammates ko 5m ke andara rakhen; alaga-alaga angles para phailane se pahale regroup call den.

Ice Iron ko thode samaya ke Support Effect ki taraha len, lagaataara Healing ki taraha nahin. baara-baara Gloo Wall lagaakara Recovery stack hone ki ummida na karen; deployment kaa samaya squad ki movement ke hisaaba se rakhen.
strengthsEn: Adds a short durability-restoration window to deployed Gloo Walls, helping the squad maintain temporary cover.
Provides nearby teammates with a small HP-recovery window when they stay within 5m.
strengthsHi: Deployed Gloo Walls ko thode samaya ke lie extra Durability milati hai, jisase squad kaa temporary cover banaa raha sakataa hai.
5m ke andara rahane vaale teammates ko HP Recovery ki chhoti Window milati hai.
limitationsEn: The post-deployment effect window is only 1.5 seconds, so timing matters.
The teammate-healing effect does not stack from deploying multiple Gloo Walls.
Garena does not publish a current per-wall maximum HP recovery total for each teammate.
limitationsHi: Deployment ke baada Effect Window sirpha 1.5 seconds ki hai, isalie timing jaruri hai.
kai Gloo Walls lagaane se Teammate Healing Effect stack nahin hotaa.
Garena, hara teammate ke lie eka Gloo Wall se milane vaali current maximum HP Recovery publish nahin karataa.

name: Otho
introEn: Passive ability that marks nearby enemy teammates after a knockdown and applies a short movement-speed reduction.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo Knockdown ke baada aasapaasa maujuda Enemy teammates ko mark karati hai aur thode samaya ke lie unaki Movement Speed kama karati hai.
currentEn: After Otho knocks down an enemy, Memory Mist marks that enemy's teammates within 20m of the knocked-down enemy.
Marked enemies have their movement speed reduced by 25% for 3 seconds.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, Memory Mist marks and slows the attacker and their teammates.
currentHi: Otho ke kisi Enemy ko Knockdown karane ke baada Memory Mist, Knock hue Enemy se 20m ke andara maujuda usake teammates ko mark karati hai.
Mark hue Enemy ki Movement Speed 3 seconds ke lie 25% kama ho jaati hai.
agara Otho ko koi paasa kaa Enemy Knockdown karataa hai, to Memory Mist usa attacker aur usake teammates ko mark karake unaki Speed kama karati hai.
notesEn: The 20m range is stated for the enemy-knockdown trigger. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
Garena does not publish the maximum number of players that Memory Mist can mark.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karane vaale Trigger ke lie 20m Range di gai hai. khuda Knockdown hone vaale Trigger ki alaga numeric Range Garena publish nahin karataa.
Memory Mist kitane maximum players ko mark kara sakati hai, yaha Garena publish nahin karataa.
Garena isa Passive Ability kaa numeric Cooldown publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum reveal range increased from 50m to 75m; teammate information-sharing duration increased from 4s to 6s.

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist reworked: after knocking down an enemy, it marks enemies within 20m of the knocked-down enemy and slows them by 25% for 4s; when Otho is knocked down, it also marks and slows nearby enemies.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): The mark-and-slow duration changed from 4s to 3s.
historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Reveal Range 50m se badhaakara 75m; Teammates ke saatha Information Sharing Duration 4s se badhaakara 6s ki gai.

OB39 (21 Mar 2023): Memory Mist ko rework kiyaa gayaa: Enemy ko Knockdown karane ke baada vaha Knock hue Enemy se 20m ke andara maujuda Enemy ko mark karati hai aur 4s ke lie unaki Speed 25% kama karati hai; Otho ke Knockdown hone para bhi aasapaasa ke Enemy mark aur slow hote hain.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Mark aur Slow ki Duration 4s se ghataakara 3s ki gai.

source.label: Garena — Official Otho full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After a knockdown, use the 20m mark around the downed opponent to call the nearby enemy positions before the squad commits to a follow-up.
The 3-second slow creates a brief timing advantage: coordinate a reposition, safer angle change or reset while the marked group is slowed.
If Otho is knocked down by a nearby enemy, immediately communicate the trigger so teammates know the attacker and nearby group have been marked and slowed.
tacticalHi: Knockdown ke baada down hue opponent ke aasapaasa 20m men mark hue Enemy ki location call karen, phira squad ko aage badhaaen.
3-second Slow se thode samaya kaa advantage milataa hai: isa dauraana position badalen, behatara angle len yaa reset karen.
agara Otho ko koi paasa kaa Enemy Knockdown karataa hai, to turnta teammates ko bataaen, taaki unhen pataa rahe ki attacker aur aasapaasa ki team mark aur slow ho chuki hai.
strengthsEn: A knockdown can reveal the downed enemy's nearby teammates, giving the squad information for its next decision.
The 25% movement-speed reduction can briefly disrupt an enemy group's reposition.
The self-knockdown trigger can also mark and slow the nearby attacker and their teammates.
strengthsHi: Knockdown se down hue Enemy ke aasapaasa maujuda teammates ki location pataa chala sakati hai, jisase squad agalaa phaisalaa le sakati hai.
25% Movement Speed Reduction kuchha samaya ke lie Enemy team ki repositioning bigaada sakati hai.
khuda Knockdown hone para bhi yaha paasa ke attacker aur usake teammates ko mark aur slow kara sakati hai.
limitationsEn: The main trigger requires Otho to knock down an enemy; it is not a continuous scan.
The published 20m range is measured from the knocked-down enemy. Garena does not publish a separate numeric range for the self-knockdown trigger.
The mark-and-slow effect lasts only 3 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum mark count.
limitationsHi: mukhya Trigger ke lie Otho ko Enemy Knockdown karanaa jaruri hai; yaha lagaataara chalane vaalaa Scan nahin hai.
bataai gai 20m Range, Knock hue Enemy se maapi jaati hai. khuda Knockdown hone vaale Trigger ki alaga numeric Range Garena publish nahin karataa.
Mark aur Slow Effect sirpha 3 seconds rahataa hai aur maximum mark count Garena publish nahin karataa.

name: Leon
introEn: Passive ability that restores HP after Leon survives combat.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo Combat se bacha nikalane ke baada Leon ko HP vaapasa deti hai.
currentEn: After surviving combat, Leon recovers 60 HP at a rate of 4 HP per second for 15 seconds.
currentHi: Combat se bachane ke baada Leon 15 seconds taka hara second 4 HP ki dara se kula 60 HP recover karataa hai.
notesEn: The recovery begins after the game registers that Leon has survived combat.
Garena does not publish the exact combat-disengagement timer that determines when the recovery trigger begins.
Garena does not publish a numeric cooldown for this passive ability.
notesHi: Game dvaaraa Leon ke Combat se bacha nikalane ki pushti karane ke baada Recovery shuru hoti hai.
Recovery Trigger shuru hone kaa exact Combat-disengagement timer Garena publish nahin karataa.
Garena isa Passive Ability kaa numeric Cooldown publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum recovery increased from 30 HP to 60 HP; recovery rate changed from 5 to 4 HP/s; maximum recovery duration changed from 6s to 15s.
historyHi: OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Maximum Recovery 30 HP se badhaakara 60 HP ki gai; Recovery Rate 5 se ghataakara 4 HP/s aur Maximum Recovery Duration 6s se badhaakara 15s ki gai.

source.label: Garena — Official Leon full-body character artwork

tacticalEn: After an engagement ends, create space behind cover and let Buzzer Beater's recovery tick before taking another contested position.
Use the recovery window to regroup with teammates and prepare the next rotation instead of treating the passive as an emergency instant heal.
Call out when you are disengaging so the squad can avoid leaving Leon isolated while the recovery is taking effect.
tacticalHi: Engagement khatma hone ke baada cover ke pichhe jagaha banaaen aur dusari contested position lene se pahale Buzzer Beater ki Recovery hone den.
Recovery Window kaa istemaala teammates ke saatha regroup aur agali rotation ki taiyaari ke lie karen; ise turnta milane vaali Emergency Heal na samajhen.
jaba aapa fight se disengage kara rahe hon to teammates ko call den, taaki Recovery ke dauraana Leon akelaa na chhute.
strengthsEn: Provides up to 60 HP of recovery after surviving combat without requiring a manual activation.
The 15-second recovery window can support a reset between engagements.
strengthsHi: Manual Activation ke binaa Combat se bachane ke baada maximum 60 HP Recovery milati hai.
15-second Recovery Window do engagements ke bicha reset karane men madada kara sakati hai.
limitationsEn: Recovery is gradual at 4 HP/s, not an instant HP burst.
The trigger is tied to surviving combat; Garena does not publish the exact disengagement timer.
It does not replace cover or teammate support during an active engagement.
limitationsHi: Recovery dhire-dhire 4 HP/s ki dara se hoti hai, turnta HP nahin milati.
Trigger, Combat se bachane para nirbhara hai; exact disengagement timer Garena publish nahin karataa.
Active Engagement ke dauraana yaha cover yaa teammate support ki jagaha nahin leti.

name: Koda
introEn: Active ability that activates an aurora effect, increases movement speed and periodically reveals enemies behind cover.
introHi: eka Active Ability, jo Aurora Effect chaalu karati hai, Movement Speed badhaati hai aur samaya-samaya para cover ke pichhe maujuda Enemy ko reveal karati hai.
currentEn: Activates the Aurora power for 8 seconds and increases movement speed by 15%.
Reveals enemies behind cover within 50m every 1 second; crouching or prone enemies cannot be detected.
While parachuting, highlights enemy locations within the field of view, but the effect is not shared with teammates.
currentHi: 8 seconds ke lie Aurora Power activate hoti hai aur Movement Speed 15% badha jaati hai.
hara 1 second men 50m ke andara cover ke pichhe maujuda Enemy reveal hote hain; crouch yaa prone Enemy detect nahin hote.
Parachuting ke dauraana Field of View men aane vaali Enemy ki locations highlight hoti hain, lekina yaha Effect teammates ke saatha share nahin hotaa.
notesEn: The parachuting highlight is visible only to Koda's user.

OB54 lists two optional BR Skill Boosts, separate from the base Aurora Vision values: Synced Vision marks enemies revealed during the first detection interval for 3 seconds and shares the information with teammates; Imprinted Vision applies up to 3 stacks, with 10 additional DMG per stack when the imprints are activated by an attack.
Only one of the two Skill Boost options can be selected. OB54 did not change the base duration, movement-speed bonus, detection range or cooldown.
notesHi: Parachuting ke dauraana milane vaalaa Highlight sirpha Koda ko dikhaai detaa hai.

OB54 men do optional BR Skill Boosts die gae hain, jo base Aurora Vision values se alaga hain: Synced Vision, pahale Detection Interval men reveal hue Enemy ko 3 seconds ke lie mark karake jaanakaari teammates ke saatha share karataa hai; Imprinted Vision maximum 3 stacks lagaataa hai, aur Attack se Imprints activate hone para hara stack 10 extra DMG detaa hai.
donon Skill Boost options men se sirpha eka chunaa jaa sakataa hai. OB54 men base Duration, Movement Speed Bonus, Detection Range yaa Cooldown nahin badale gae.
historyEn: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda introduced with a 10s Aurora duration, +10% movement speed, 50m detection every 1s, a 60s cooldown, and a parachuting highlight not shared with teammates.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 15%; cooldown reduced from 60s to 45s.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora duration reduced from 10s to 8s.

historyHi: OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Koda ko 10s Aurora Duration, +10% Movement Speed, hara 1s men 50m Detection, 60s Cooldown aur teammates ke saatha share na hone vaale Parachuting Highlight ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Movement Speed Bonus 10% se badhaakara 15%; Cooldown 60s se ghataakara 45s kiyaa gayaa.
OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Aurora Duration 10s se ghataakara 8s ki gai.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): do optional BR Skill Boosts phira se die gae: Synced Vision (3s Shared Mark) aur Imprinted Vision (maximum 3 stacks; activate hone para hara stack 10 DMG).

tacticalEn: Activate Aurora Vision before entering a contested rotation or checking likely enemy cover, then share each reveal with the squad through clear callouts.
Use the 15% movement-speed bonus to reposition with teammates while the detection window is active; do not assume every enemy will be revealed.
During parachuting, use the personal field-of-view highlights to call out visible locations because that information is not shared automatically with teammates.
tacticalHi: Contested rotation men jaane yaa snbhaavita enemy cover check karane se pahale Aurora Vision activate karen, phira hara reveal ki jaanakaari squad ko saapha callouts men den.
Detection Window active rahate hue 15% Movement Speed Bonus kaa istemaala teammates ke saatha reposition karane men karen; yaha na maanen ki hara Enemy reveal ho jaaegaa.
Parachuting ke dauraana Field of View men dikhane vaali locations call karen, kyonki yaha jaanakaari apane aapa teammates ke saatha share nahin hoti.
strengthsEn: Periodically reveals enemies behind cover within 50m, excluding crouching and prone targets.
Adds a 15% movement-speed bonus during the 8-second Aurora window.
Can highlight visible enemy locations during parachuting for the user.
strengthsHi: 50m ke andara cover ke pichhe maujuda Enemy ko samaya-samaya para reveal karati hai; crouching aur prone targets detect nahin hote.
8-second Aurora Window ke dauraana 15% Movement Speed Bonus deti hai.
Parachuting ke dauraana user ko visible enemy locations highlight kara sakati hai.
limitationsEn: The active window lasts 8 seconds and the cooldown is 45 seconds.
Crouching and prone enemies cannot be detected by the behind-cover scan.
Parachuting highlights are not shared with teammates.
OB54 Skill Boosts are optional BR enhancements and are separate from the base Aurora Vision values.
limitationsHi: Active Window 8 seconds ki hai aur Cooldown 45 seconds hai.
Behind-cover Scan se crouching aur prone Enemy detect nahin hote.
Parachuting Highlights teammates ke saatha share nahin hote.
OB54 Skill Boosts optional BR enhancements hain aur base Aurora Vision values se alaga hain.

name: Thiva
introEn: Passive support ability that speeds up teammate help-ups and restores HP to the teammate who is successfully helped up.
introHi: eka Passive Support Ability, jo teammates ko help up karane ki Speed badhaati hai aur saphalataapurvaka help up hue teammate ko HP vaapasa deti hai.
currentEn: The speed of helping up teammates is increased by 70%.
After a successful help-up, the helped-up teammate recovers 60 HP over 3 seconds.
currentHi: Teammates ko help up karane ki Speed 70% badha jaati hai.
saphala Help-up ke baada usa teammate ko 3 seconds men 60 HP vaapasa milati hai.
notesEn: The HP recovery is applied to the teammate who was successfully helped up.
notesHi: HP Recovery usi teammate ko milati hai jise saphalataapurvaka help up kiyaa gayaa ho.

OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes reworked to +70% help-up speed, 60s cooldown and 100 HP recovered by the helped-up teammate over 3s.

historyHi: OB33 (23 Mar 2022): Maximum Help-up Speed 25% se badhaakara 30%; saphala Rescue ke baada HP Recovery 40 HP se badhaakara 5s men 50 HP ki gai.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Vital Vibes ko rework karake +70% Help-up Speed, 60s Cooldown aur help-up hue teammate ko 3s men 100 HP Recovery di gai.

After a successful help-up, keep the rescued teammate with the squad while the 60 HP recovery is applied over 3 seconds.
Track the 90-second cooldown and coordinate the next rescue window rather than assuming Vital Vibes is always available.
tacticalHi: Teammate Knockdown hone para cover ke pichhe surakshita Help-up ko priority den; Thiva ki 70% faster Help-up Speed se Rescue ke dauraana squad ko kama samaya taka exposed rahanaa padataa hai.
Successful Help-up ke baada rescued teammate ko squad ke saatha rakhen, taaki use 3 seconds men milane vaali 60 HP Recovery kaa phaayadaa mila sake.
90-second Cooldown kaa dhyaana rakhen aur agali Rescue Window coordinate karen; Vital Vibes ko hara samaya available na maanen.
strengthsEn: Increases teammate help-up speed by 70%, reducing the time needed to complete a rescue.
The successfully helped-up teammate receives 60 HP over 3 seconds.
strengthsHi: Teammate Help-up Speed 70% badhaati hai, jisase Rescue puraa karane men kama samaya lagataa hai.
saphalataapurvaka help up hue teammate ko 3 seconds men 60 HP milati hai.
limitationsEn: The ability has a 90-second cooldown.
The 60 HP recovery applies only after a successful help-up.
It does not provide a direct benefit while all teammates are already standing.
limitationsHi: isa Ability kaa Cooldown 90 seconds hai.
60 HP Recovery sirpha successful Help-up ke baada milati hai.
jaba sabhi teammates pahale se khade hon, taba yaha sidhaa koi phaayadaa nahin deti.

name: Dimitri
introEn: Active healing zone that restores HP to Dimitri and nearby allies, and automatically starts self-recovery for downed players inside it.
introHi: eka Active Healing Zone, jo Dimitri aur aasapaasa ke allies ko HP vaapasa deti hai. isake andara Knock hue players kaa Self-recovery apane aapa shuru ho jaataa hai.
currentEn: Creates a healing zone with a 3.5m radius.
Dimitri and allies inside the zone recover 10 HP per second.
When Dimitri or an ally is downed inside the zone, self-recovery automatically starts when needed.
The zone lasts 12 seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
currentHi: 3.5m Radius vaalaa Healing Zone banaataa hai.
Zone ke andara Dimitri aur allies hara second 10 HP recover karate hain.
Zone ke andara Dimitri yaa koi ally Knockdown ho jaae, to jarurata padane para Self-recovery apane aapa shuru ho jaataa hai.
Zone 12 seconds taka rahataa hai. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
notesEn: OB40 states that the help-up effect can be enhanced by other skills.
During self-recovery, players can move and no longer lose HP (OB34).
Garena does not publish a separate maximum number of self-recovery activations within one zone.
notesHi: OB40 ke mutaabika Help-up Effect ko dusari Skills se badhaayaa jaa sakataa hai.
Self-recovery ke dauraana players move kara sakate hain aur unaki HP kama nahin hoti (OB34).
eka Zone ke andara Self-recovery kitani baara activate ho sakataa hai, isaki maximum snkhyaa Garena publish nahin karataa.

OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery was improved so players could move during it without losing HP.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP recovery increased from 3 to 5 HP/s.
OB40 (30 May 2023): HP recovery increased from 5 to 10 HP/s; downed players inside the zone automatically began self-recovery when needed; zone duration became 12s and cooldown was 60s.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown increased from 60s to 90s.
historyHi: 4th Anniversary (04 Aug 2021): Healing Heartbeat introduce huaa — 3.5m Healing Zone, 3 HP/s, maximum level para 15s taka Duration aur 60s Cooldown; Knock hue users aur allies khuda Self-recover kara sakate the.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Self-recovery ko behatara kiyaa gayaa, taaki isake dauraana players binaa HP khoe move kara saken.
OB37 (21 Sep 2022): HP Recovery 3 se badhaakara 5 HP/s ki gai.

OB40 (30 May 2023): HP Recovery 5 se badhaakara 10 HP/s ki gai; Zone ke andara Knock hue players kaa Self-recovery jarurata padane para apane aapa shuru hone lagaa; Zone Duration 12s aur Cooldown 60s huaa.
OB42 (30 Oct 2023): Cooldown 60s se badhaakara 90s kiyaa gayaa.

hiddenMechanics.text: While self-recovering, the player can move and no longer loses HP (OB34).

If a teammate is downed inside the zone, communicate that self-recovery may start automatically; do not assume the area is safe from interruption.
tacticalHi: Regroup karane se pahale Healing Zone ki location call karen, taaki teammates ko usakaa Support Area pataa rahe.
agara Zone ke andara koi teammate Knockdown ho jaae, to bataaen ki usakaa Self-recovery apane aapa shuru ho sakataa hai; yaha na maanen ki vaha jagaha interruption se puri taraha safe hai.
strengthsEn: Provides HP recovery to Dimitri and nearby allies during the active zone.
Can automatically start self-recovery for downed players inside the zone.
strengthsHi: Active Zone ke dauraana Dimitri aur aasapaasa ke allies ko HP Recovery milati hai.
Zone ke andara Knock hue players kaa Self-recovery apane aapa shuru kara sakataa hai.
limitationsEn: The support area is limited to a 3.5m radius and lasts 12 seconds.
The 90-second cooldown means the zone is not continuously available.
limitationsHi: Support Area sirpha 3.5m Radius taka simita hai aur 12 seconds taka rahataa hai.
90-second Cooldown ke kaarana Zone lagaataara available nahin rahataa.

name: Skyler
introEn: Active sonic-wave skill that damages Gloo Walls in an area and can store up to two charges.
introHi: eka Active Sonic-wave Skill, jo Area men Gloo Walls ko Damage karati hai aur maximum do Charges store kara sakati hai.
currentEn: Unleashes a sonic wave forward; OB55 states that the actual skill-effect range is over 100m, but does not publish an exact distance.
When the wave hits an obstacle, it explodes and deals 500 DMG per second to Gloo Walls within a 4m radius.
The damage effect lasts 6 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Up to 2 skill charges can be stored.
HP recovery is not included in the current base-skill values used here; the OB38 rework removed Skyler's healing effect.
currentHi: aage ki tarapha Sonic Wave chhodataa hai; OB55 ke mutaabika Skill kaa actual effect range 100m se jyaadaa hai, lekina exact distance publish nahin ki gai.
Wave kisi obstacle se takaraane para explode hoti hai aur 4m Radius ke andara Gloo Walls ko hara second 500 DMG deti hai.
Damage Effect 6 seconds taka rahataa hai. Cooldown: 45 seconds. Maximum 2 Skill Charges store ho sakati hain.
yahaan istemaala kie gae current base-skill values men HP Recovery shaamila nahin hai; OB38 rework men Skyler kaa Healing Effect hataa diyaa gayaa thaa.
notesEn: OB55 says the skill-effect visibility was extended to match the actual range of over 100m. Garena does not publish the exact range.
