Exact damage values for these boosts are not published.
Only one Skill Boost option can be selected for the skill in a match.
OB47 added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls; OB49 added an obstacle indicator to the aiming line.
notesHi: OB55 ke mutaabika Skill Effect ki visibility ko actual range yaani 100m se jyaadaa ke anusaara badhaayaa gayaa. Garena exact range publish nahin karataa.

OB54 men do optional BR Skill Boosts jode gae: Sticky Rhythm eka chhotaa Area banaataa hai jo sabase najadiki Enemy ke pichhe chalataa hai aur usake andara Gloo Walls ko Damage karataa hai; Split Rhythm 75m ke andara Gloo Walls khojataa hai, 15s taka target walls ko lock karataa hai aur maximum 3 walls ki tarapha waves bhejataa hai. ina boosts ki exact Damage values publish nahin ki gain.
eka match men Skill ke lie sirpha eka Skill Boost option chunaa jaa sakataa hai.
OB47 men Gloo Walls ki tarapha Aim Assistance jodi gai; OB49 men Aiming Line para Obstacle Indicator jodaa gayaa.
historyEn: OB34 (25 May 2022): At maximum level, cooldown increased from 40s to 60s; each deployed Gloo Wall granted HP recovery, up to 9 points, and recovery effects did not stack.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Reworked into area damage over time; maximum wave range 100m, 3.5m damage radius, 4s duration and 50s cooldown. HP recovery was removed.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage radius increased from 3.5m to 4m; duration increased from 4s to 5s; cooldown reduced from 50s to 45s.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration increased from 5s to 6s; cooldown reduced from 45s to 40s.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Added up to 2 stored charges; published values were 500 DMG/s within 4m for 6s, with a 45s cooldown and up to 100m wave range.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Added aim assistance toward Gloo Walls.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Added an obstacle indicator to the skill's aiming line.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Added optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm and Split Rhythm.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Extended skill-effect visibility to match the actual range of over 100m; the exact range was not published.
historyHi: OB34 (25 May 2022): Maximum Level para Cooldown 40s se badhaakara 60s kiyaa gayaa; hara deployed Gloo Wall se maximum 9 points taka HP Recovery milati thi aur Recovery Effects stack nahin hote the.
OB38 (11 Jan 2023): Area Damage over Time men rework kiyaa gayaa; maximum Wave Range 100m, Damage Radius 3.5m, Duration 4s aur Cooldown 50s huaa. HP Recovery hataa di gai.
OB40 (30 May 2023): Damage Radius 3.5m se badhaakara 4m; Duration 4s se badhaakara 5s; Cooldown 50s se ghataakara 45s kiyaa gayaa.
OB41 (08 Aug 2023): Duration 5s se badhaakara 6s; Cooldown 45s se ghataakara 40s kiyaa gayaa.
OB45 (26 Jun 2024): Maximum 2 Stored Charges jodi gain; published values 4m ke andara 6s taka 500 DMG/s, 45s Cooldown aur maximum 100m Wave Range thin.
OB47 (02 Dec 2024): Gloo Walls ki tarapha Aim Assistance jodi gai.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Skill ki Aiming Line para Obstacle Indicator jodaa gayaa.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Optional BR Skill Boosts Sticky Rhythm aur Split Rhythm jode gae.
OB55 (10 Sep 2026): Skill Effect Visibility ko 100m se jyaadaa actual range ke anusaara badhaayaa gayaa; exact range publish nahin ki gai.

hiddenMechanics.text: Riptide Rhythm receives aim assistance toward Gloo Walls (OB47).
An obstacle indicator appears on the aiming line (OB49).

tacticalEn: Communicate the intended route before relying on a Gloo Wall interaction; teammates should know which area is being affected.
Treat the exact wave range as unpublished: OB55 confirms it is over 100m but gives no precise distance.
tacticalHi: Gloo Wall interaction para nirbhara hone se pahale intended route call karen, taaki teammates ko pataa ho ki kisa Area para effect padegaa.
Wave ki exact Range ko unpublished maanen: OB55 sirpha confirm karataa hai ki yaha 100m se jyaadaa hai, exact distance nahin bataataa.
strengthsEn: The sonic-wave effect can affect Gloo Walls within a 4m radius for 6 seconds.
The skill can store up to two charges.
strengthsHi: Sonic-wave Effect 4m Radius ke andara Gloo Walls ko 6 seconds taka prabhaavita kara sakataa hai.
Skill maximum do Charges store kara sakati hai.
limitationsEn: The exact actual range above 100m is not published by Garena.
The skill has a 45-second cooldown; stored charges do not make it continuously available.
limitationsHi: 100m se jyaadaa ki exact actual Range Garena ne publish nahin ki hai.
Skill kaa Cooldown 45 seconds hai; Stored Charges hone kaa matalaba yaha nahin ki Skill lagaataara available rahegi.

name: Xayne
introEn: Active skill that grants temporary Shield Points, which refill and refresh the skill duration when Xayne knocks down an enemy.
introHi: eka Active Skill, jo temporary Shield Points deti hai. Xayne ke Enemy ko Knockdown karane para Shield Points phira bhara jaate hain aur Skill Duration reset ho jaati hai.
currentEn: Enters the Xtreme state and instantly gains 70 temporary Shield Points for 15 seconds.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the temporary Shield Points from this skill back to 70 and resets the state duration.
When the state ends, the Shield Points gained through this skill are removed. Cooldown: 75 seconds.
currentHi: Xtreme State activate hoti hai aur turnta 15 seconds ke lie 70 temporary Shield Points milate hain.
isa State ke dauraana hara enemy Knockdown para isa Skill ke temporary Shield Points vaapasa 70 ho jaate hain aur State Duration reset ho jaati hai.
State khatma hone para isa Skill se mile Shield Points hata jaate hain. Cooldown: 75 seconds.

rows.value: Garena does not publish this value

notesEn: The temporary Shield Points from Xtreme Encounter are removed when the state ends; they are not permanent HP.
Each enemy knockdown during the active state restores this skill's temporary Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
Garena does not publish a maximum number of duration refreshes.
notesHi: Xtreme Encounter se mile temporary Shield Points, State khatma hone para hata jaate hain; ye permanent HP nahin hain.
Active State ke dauraana hara enemy Knockdown para isa Skill ke temporary Shield Points vaapasa 70 ho jaate hain aur Duration reset hoti hai.
Duration kitani baara maximum refresh ho sakati hai, yaha Garena publish nahin karataa.
historyEn: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): Introduced with 80 temporary HP, up to 100% increased damage to Gloo Walls and shields, 10s duration and 100s cooldown at maximum level.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 100% to 130%; duration increased from 10s to 15s. Maximum cooldown remained 100s.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP increased from 80 to 120; maximum Gloo Wall/shield damage bonus increased from 130% to 200%; duration reduced from 15s to 6s.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Reworked from temporary HP to 60 temporary Shield Points for 12s; each enemy knockdown restored the shield to 60 and reset duration; cooldown became 75s.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points reduced from 60 to 50; duration remained 12s and cooldown remained 75s.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points increased from 50 to 70 and duration increased from 12s to 15s; cooldown remained 75s.
historyHi: Patch Note: World Series (14 Apr 2021): 80 temporary HP, Gloo Walls aur Shields para maximum 100% extra Damage, 10s Duration aur maximum level para 100s Cooldown ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa.
Illuminate (19 Jan 2022): Maximum Gloo Wall/Shield Damage Bonus 100% se badhaakara 130%; Duration 10s se badhaakara 15s ki gai. Maximum Cooldown 100s hi rahaa.
OB34 (25 May 2022): Temporary HP 80 se badhaakara 120; Maximum Gloo Wall/Shield Damage Bonus 130% se badhaakara 200%; Duration 15s se ghataakara 6s ki gai.
OB46 (01 Sep 2024): Temporary HP ki jagaha 12s ke lie 60 temporary Shield Points die gae; hara enemy Knockdown para Shield 60 taka refill aur Duration reset hoti thi; Cooldown 75s huaa.
OB48 (19 Feb 2025): Temporary Shield Points 60 se ghataakara 50 kie gae; Duration 12s aur Cooldown 75s rahe.
OB52 (09 Jan 2026): Temporary Shield Points 50 se badhaakara 70 aur Duration 12s se badhaakara 15s ki gai; Cooldown 75s rahaa.
tacticalEn: Tell teammates when the temporary Shield Point state begins and when it expires so they do not mistake it for permanent protection.
A knockdown during the active state refreshes the Shield Points and duration; the profile does not assume a maximum refresh count.
tacticalHi: Teammates ko bataaen ki temporary Shield Point State kaba shuru aur khatma hoti hai, taaki ve ise permanent Protection na samajhen.
Active State ke dauraana Knockdown hone para Shield Points aur Duration refresh hote hain; profile kisi maximum refresh count kaa daavaa nahin karati.
strengthsEn: Grants 70 temporary Shield Points for a 15-second state.
Each enemy knockdown during the state restores the skill's Shield Points to 70 and resets the duration.
strengthsHi: 15-second State ke lie 70 temporary Shield Points deti hai.
State ke dauraana hara enemy Knockdown para Skill ke Shield Points vaapasa 70 ho jaate hain aur Duration reset hoti hai.
limitationsEn: Shield Points gained from the skill are removed when the state ends.
The cooldown is 75 seconds, and Garena does not publish a maximum refresh count.
limitationsHi: State khatma hone para Skill se mile Shield Points hata jaate hain.
Cooldown 75 seconds hai aur maximum refresh count Garena publish nahin karataa.

name: Lila
introEn: Passive that decelerates enemies and vehicles shot with rifles, freezing them and generating Gloo Walls upon knockdown.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Rifles se hit hue Enemy aur Vehicles ki Speed kama karati hai. Knockdown hone para Enemy freeze ho jaate hain aur extra Gloo Walls milati hain.
currentEn: When hitting enemies or vehicles with rifles or marksman rifles, reduces the enemies' movement speed by 10% or the vehicles' acceleration by 80% for 3 seconds. If the enemy is knocked down while decelerated, freezes them for up to 3 seconds and obtains 2 extra Gloo Walls.
currentHi: Rifles yaa Marksman Rifles se Enemy yaa Vehicles ko hit karane para Enemy ki Movement Speed 10% yaa Vehicles ki Acceleration 80% kama ho jaati hai. yaha Effect 3 seconds taka rahataa hai. Slow hue Enemy ko Knockdown karane para vaha maximum 3 seconds ke lie freeze ho jaataa hai aur 2 extra Gloo Walls milati hain.
notesEn: The OB47 patch removed the original 10-second cooldown, making the skill continuously active upon landing successful rifle shots.
notesHi: OB47 Patch ne original 10-second Cooldown hataa diyaa, isalie saphala Rifle Hits lagane para Skill lagaataara active rahati hai.
historyEn: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduced. OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle decel 50% to 80%, removed 10s skill cooldown. OB49 (21 May 2025): Gloo Wall reward upon knock increased from 1 to 2.
historyHi: OB46 (Aug 2024): Introduce kiyaa gayaa. OB47 (Oct 2024): Vehicle Deceleration 50% se badhaakara 80%; 10s Skill Cooldown hataayaa gayaa. OB49 (21 May 2025): Knock para Gloo Wall Reward 1 se badhaakara 2 kiyaa gayaa.

rowsHi.hi: Enemy ki Movement Speed men kami

tacticalEn: Use rifle hits to slow a moving enemy before your squad commits; a knock while slowed grants extra Gloo Walls for the next cover/rotation.
tacticalHi: Squad ke commit karane se pahale moving Enemy para Rifle Hits lagaakara usaki Speed kama karen; Slow rahate hue Knockdown karane para agali cover yaa rotation ke lie extra Gloo Walls milati hain.
strengthsEn: Repeated rifle hits can apply the slow without a cooldown; knockdown reward supports cover economy.
strengthsHi: Repeated Rifle Hits binaa Cooldown ke Slow apply kara sakati hain; Knockdown Reward se cover ke options badhate hain.
limitationsEn: The freeze and Gloo Wall reward require a knock while the target is decelerated; the slow alone does not guarantee either.
limitationsHi: Freeze aur Gloo Wall Reward tabhi milate hain jaba target Decelerated rahate hue Knockdown ho; sirpha Slow lagane se inamen se koi Effect pakkaa nahin hotaa.

name: Maro
introEn: Passive that scales weapon damage based on the distance to the target and deals extra damage to marked enemies.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo target se duri ke hisaaba se Weapon Damage badhaati hai aur Mark hue Enemy ko extra Damage deti hai.
currentEn: Damage increases with distance, up to a maximum of 20%. Damage to marked enemies increases by 5%.
currentHi: duri badhane ke saatha Damage badhataa hai, maximum 20% taka. Mark hue Enemy ko 5% extra Damage milataa hai.
notesEn: Highly synergistic with information-gathering characters like Moco and Shirou.
notesHi: Moco aur Shirou jaise Information dene vaale characters ke saatha isakaa achchhaa taalamela hai.
historyEn: OB41 (Aug 2023): Damage to marked enemies increased from 3.5% to 5%. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum distance damage bonus nerfed from 25% to 20%.
historyHi: OB41 (Aug 2023): Mark hue Enemy ko Damage 3.5% se badhaakara 5% kiyaa gayaa. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Maximum Distance Damage Bonus 25% se ghataakara 20% kiyaa gayaa.
tacticalEn: Pair with teammate information marks; maintain distance when the engagement allows to benefit from the distance-scaled bonus.
tacticalHi: Teammate ke Information Marks ke saatha ise use karen; fight men maukaa mile to duri banaae rakhen, taaki distance-based Bonus kaa phaayadaa mile.
strengthsEn: Combines distance scaling with a separate marked-target bonus; passive has no cooldown.
strengthsHi: Distance Scaling ke saatha Mark hue target para alaga Bonus bhi milataa hai; Passive kaa Cooldown nahin hai.
limitationsEn: The maximum distance bonus scales with range and is not the full 20% at every distance; close-range fights reduce its value.
limitationsHi: Maximum Distance Bonus duri ke saatha badhataa hai aur hara Range para puraa 20% nahin milataa; close-range fights men isakaa phaayadaa kama hotaa hai.

name: Shirou
introEn: Passive that marks attackers who hit the user and grants massive armor penetration on the first retaliatory shot.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo aapako hit karane vaale attackers ko mark karati hai aur javaabi pahali Shot para bahuta jyaadaa Armor Penetration deti hai.
currentEn: When hit by an enemy from within 100m, the attacker is marked for 8 seconds. Intel is shared with teammates. The first shot on marked enemies has 100% additional armor penetration. Maximum of 4 markings active at once.
currentHi: 100m ke andara maujuda Enemy se Hit hone para attacker 8 seconds ke lie mark ho jaataa hai. yaha jaanakaari teammates ke saatha share hoti hai. Mark hue Enemy para pahali Shot ko 100% extra Armor Penetration milati hai. eka samaya men maximum 4 Marks active raha sakate hain.

rows.value: Garena does not publish current cooldown

notesEn: The mark is universally visible to all teammates. Garena has not republished the cooldown value since it was reduced to 10 seconds in OB36.
notesHi: Mark sabhi teammates ko dikhaai detaa hai. OB36 men Cooldown 10 seconds kie jaane ke baada Garena ne isaki value dobaaraa publish nahin ki hai.
historyEn: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m to 100m, Armor pen to 100%, Cooldown 25s to 10s. OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Marking duration 10s to 8s, Max markings explicitly capped at 4.
historyHi: OB36 (Sep 2022): Range 80m se badhaakara 100m, Armor Penetration 100% aur Cooldown 25s se ghataakara 10s kiyaa gayaa. OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Marking Duration 10s se ghataakara 8s; Maximum Marks ki limit 4 taya ki gai.
tacticalEn: When your squad is hit, use the shared mark to call the attacker's location and coordinate a response; the first shot receives the penetration bonus.
tacticalHi: Squad ko Hit hone para shared Mark se attacker ki location call karen aur javaabi action coordinate karen; pahali Shot ko Penetration Bonus milataa hai.
strengthsEn: Attacker information is shared teamwide; the first retaliatory shot gains 100% additional armor penetration.
strengthsHi: Attacker ki jaanakaari puri team ke saatha share hoti hai; javaabi pahali Shot ko 100% extra Armor Penetration milati hai.
limitationsEn: Marking requires Shirou to be hit by an enemy within range; it is reactive, not a proactive scan.
limitationsHi: Marking ke lie Shirou ko Range ke andara kisi Enemy se Hit honaa jaruri hai; yaha reactive Skill hai, pahale se Scan nahin karati.

name: Chrono
introEn: Active ability that creates an impenetrable static force field blocking incoming and outgoing damage.
introHi: eka Active Ability, jo majabuta aur sthira Force Field banaati hai. yaha andara aur baahara se aane vaalaa Damage block karati hai.
currentEn: Creates an impenetrable force field that blocks 1,000 damage. Unable to attack outside enemies from within the field. All effects last for 10 seconds.
currentHi: aisaa Force Field banaataa hai jo 1,000 Damage block karataa hai. Field ke andara se baahara maujuda Enemy para Attack nahin kara sakate. sabhi Effects 10 seconds taka rahate hain.
notesEn: The shield blocks damage from all sources, both inside and out. Enemies can enter the shield dome.
notesHi: Shield andara aur baahara, donon tarapha se aane vaale sabhi sources ke Damage ko block karataa hai. Enemy Shield Dome ke andara aa sakate hain.
historyEn: OB31 (Dec 2021): Removed ability to shoot outward, duration 6s, cooldown 120s. OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s to 8s. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s to 45s, Shield HP 800 to 1000, Duration 8s to 10s.
historyHi: OB31 (Dec 2021): baahara ki tarapha Shoot karane ki Ability hataai gai; Duration 6s aur Cooldown 120s kiyaa gayaa. OB45 (Jun 2024): Duration 6s se badhaakara 8s. OB54 (23 Jun 2026): Cooldown 60s se ghataakara 45s, Shield HP 800 se badhaakara 1,000 aur Duration 8s se badhaakara 10s ki gai.
tacticalEn: Use the field to create a temporary protected space for a reset or revive; remember enemies can enter the dome and you cannot shoot outward.
tacticalHi: Reset yaa Revive ke lie Force Field se thodi dera kaa protected area banaaen; yaada rakhen ki Enemy Dome ke andara aa sakate hain aur andara se baahara Shoot nahin kara sakate.
strengthsEn: Blocks up to 1,000 damage and provides a temporary defensive window.
strengthsHi: Maximum 1,000 Damage block karataa hai aur thode samaya ke lie Defensive Window detaa hai.
limitationsEn: The field is static, enemies can enter, and outward attacks are disabled while inside.
limitationsHi: Field eka hi jagaha rahataa hai, Enemy andara aa sakate hain aur isake andara rahate hue baahara ki tarapha Attack nahin kara sakate.

name: Dasha
introEn: Passive that rewards knockdowns with a rapidly decaying rate of fire and movement speed boost.
introHi: eka Passive Skill, jo Knockdown ke baada Rate of Fire aur Movement Speed kaa Boost deti hai, lekina yaha Boost teji se kama hotaa jaataa hai.
currentEn: After knocking down an enemy, enter Highlight mode for 10 seconds. Increases rate of fire by 18% and movement speed by 12% (decays quickly). Consecutively knocking down enemies resets the countdown and further boosts rate of fire by 4% and movement speed by 3%.
currentHi: Enemy ko Knockdown karane ke baada 10 seconds ke lie Highlight Mode shuru hotaa hai. Rate of Fire 18% aur Movement Speed 12% badha jaati hai (Boost teji se kama hotaa hai). lagaataara Knockdown karane para Countdown reset hotaa hai aur Rate of Fire 4% tathaa Movement Speed 3% aur badha jaati hai.

rows.hi: Rate of Fire kaa Base Bonus

notesEn: Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it.
notesHi: Movement Speed ki eka global maximum limit hai; Skills, items aur events se milane vaale bonuses isa limit ko paara nahin kara sakate.
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill entirely reworked to Highlight mode (18% RoF, 12% Spd, 6s duration). OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration buffed from 6s to 10s.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): Skill ko puri taraha Highlight Mode men rework kiyaa gayaa (18% RoF, 12% Speed, 6s Duration). OB53 (02 Apr 2026): Duration 6s se badhaakara 10s ki gai.
rowsHi: Rate of Fire kaa Base Bonus
tacticalEn: After a knock, use the Highlight window to reposition or continue pressure; chained knockdowns refresh the timer and increase both bonuses.
tacticalHi: Knock ke baada Highlight Window kaa istemaala reposition karane yaa pressure jaari rakhane ke lie karen; lagaataara Knockdown karane para Timer reset hotaa hai aur donon Bonuses badhate hain.
strengthsEn: Knockdown-triggered momentum can be chained; no cooldown listed.
strengthsHi: Knockdown se milane vaalaa Momentum lagaataara banaae rakhaa jaa sakataa hai; koi Cooldown listed nahin hai.
limitationsEn: Highlight requires a knockdown to start; its bonuses decay quickly and movement speed remains subject to the global cap.
limitationsHi: Highlight shuru karane ke lie Knockdown jaruri hai; isake Bonuses teji se kama hote hain aur Movement Speed global cap ke andara hi rahati hai.

name: D-BEE
introEn: A passive ability that boosts movement speed and accuracy while firing on the move.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo chalate hue Fire karane para Movement Speed aur Accuracy badhaati hai.
currentEn: While firing and moving at the same time, movement speed increases by 50% and accuracy increases by 60%.
currentHi: eka hi samaya men Move karate hue Fire karane para Movement Speed 50% aur Accuracy 60% badha jaati hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The bonus requires movement and firing to happen simultaneously; standing still while firing does not meet the stated trigger.
The official character page gives a short description; the numerical values are documented in Garena's OB46 patch notes.
No separate duration or cooldown is published in the official sources checked.
notesHi: Bonus ke lie Move karanaa aur Fire karanaa eka hi samaya para jaruri hai; khade rahakara Fire karane se yaha Trigger puraa nahin hotaa.
Official Character Page para chhotaa description diyaa gayaa hai; numeric values Garena ke OB46 Patch Notes men darja hain.
jaanche gae official sources men alaga Duration yaa Cooldown publish nahin kiyaa gayaa hai.
historyEn: OB28 (Jun 2021): D-Bee introduced with Bullet Beats.
OB35 (20 Jul 2022): Movement-speed bonus increased from 10% to 20%; accuracy increased from 20% to 45%.
OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement-speed bonus increased from 30% to 50%; accuracy set to 60%.
historyHi: OB28 (Jun 2021): D-Bee ko Bullet Beats ke saatha introduce kiyaa gayaa.
OB35 (20 Jul 2022): Movement Speed Bonus 10% se badhaakara 20%; Accuracy 20% se badhaakara 45% ki gai.
OB46 (3 Sep 2024): Movement Speed Bonus 30% se badhaakara 50%; Accuracy 60% taya ki gai.
subtitle: OB55 values reconciled 15 Nov 2026
tacticalEn: The effect is conditional on simultaneous movement and firing; it does not provide the stated bonuses while stationary.
In squad play, communicate when you are repositioning so teammates can maintain shared awareness of your movement.
tacticalHi: Effect ke lie Move karanaa aur Fire karanaa eka saatha jaruri hai; khade rahane para bataae gae Bonuses nahin milate.
Squad men reposition karate samaya teammates ko call den, taaki unhen aapaki movement ki jaanakaari rahe.
strengthsEn: Provides two simultaneous passive bonuses under its stated trigger.
No active-skill activation input is required.
strengthsHi: bataae gae Trigger ke dauraana eka saatha do Passive Bonuses milate hain.
Active Skill ko manually activate karane ki jarurata nahin hai.
limitationsEn: The effect is conditional and does not apply when the character is stationary.
The official sources checked do not specify a separate duration or cooldown.
limitationsHi: yaha Effect condition para nirbhara hai aur stationary rahane para laagu nahin hotaa.
jaanche gae official sources men alaga Duration yaa Cooldown nahin diyaa gayaa hai.

name: LUQUETA
introEn: A passive ability that permanently raises maximum Shield Points with each elimination, up to a capped bonus.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo hara Elimination para maximum Shield Points badhaati hai. isakaa Bonus eka taya Limit taka hi stack hotaa hai.
currentEn: Each elimination increases maximum Shield Points by 15. The bonus stacks up to 45 Shield Points in total and is cleared when the player is eliminated or the round resets.
currentHi: hara Elimination para maximum Shield Points 15 badhate hain. Bonus kula 45 Shield Points taka stack hotaa hai aur player ke eliminate hone yaa Round reset hone para hata jaataa hai.

rows.value: Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The bonus affects maximum Shield Points, not ordinary HP.
The effect is personal to the player using Luqueta; it is not described as a squad-wide reward.
Garena's OB49 notes confirm the current +15 per elimination and +45 maximum.
notesHi: yaha Bonus maximum Shield Points badhaataa hai, saamaanya HP nahin.
yaha Effect sirpha Luqueta istemaala karane vaale player ko milataa hai; ise puri Squad kaa Reward nahin bataayaa gayaa hai.
Garena ke OB49 notes current +15 per Elimination aur +45 maximum ki pushti karate hain.
historyEn: OB23 (29 Jul 2020): Hat Trick introduced as a maximum-HP increase per elimination, capped at 35.
OB46 (1 Sep 2024): The HP bonus was converted to Shield Points; +25 per elimination, up to +50.
OB48 (Feb 2025): The per-elimination and maximum values were reduced to +20 and +40.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum stacks increased to 3; +15 per elimination and +45 maximum.
historyHi: OB23 (29 Jul 2020): Hat Trick ko hara Elimination para maximum HP badhaane vaali Skill ke rupa men introduce kiyaa gayaa, jisaki limit 35 thi.
OB46 (1 Sep 2024): HP Bonus ko Shield Points men badalaa gayaa; hara Elimination para +25, maximum +50 tak.
OB48 (Feb 2025): hara Elimination aur maximum values ghataakara +20 aur +40 ki gain.
OB49 (21 May 2025): Maximum Stacks badhaakara 3 kie gae; hara Elimination para +15 aur maximum +45 kiyaa gayaa.

source.label: Garena — OB46 Patch Notes (Shield Points conversion)

subtitle: OB55 values reconciled 15 Nov 2026
tacticalEn: The passive bonus builds only from the user's own eliminations and remains until the stated reset condition.
Keep track of the current round state because the accumulated bonus does not carry through player elimination or a round reset.
tacticalHi: Passive Bonus sirpha user ke apane Eliminations se badhataa hai aur bataai gai Reset Condition taka banaa rahataa hai.
Current Round ki sthiti para dhyaana rakhen, kyonki Player Elimination yaa Round Reset hone para jamaa Bonus aage nahin rahataa.
strengthsEn: The bonus can accumulate across up to three eliminations.
The increased maximum Shield Points remain for the rest of the round unless a reset condition occurs.
strengthsHi: Bonus maximum tina Eliminations taka jamaa ho sakataa hai.
badhe hue maximum Shield Points Reset Condition na hone para Round ke baaki samaya bane rahate hain.
limitationsEn: The ability needs eliminations to build value; it does not grant the full bonus at the start.
The accumulated effect is cleared on player elimination or round reset.
limitationsHi: Bonus badhaane ke lie Eliminations jaruri hain; shuruaata men puraa Bonus nahin milataa.
Player Elimination yaa Round Reset hone para jamaa Effect hata jaataa hai.

name: KELLY
introEn: A passive ability that increases sprinting speed and activates Deadly Velocity after a sustained sprint, empowering the first shot that hits a target during its active window.
introHi: eka Passive Ability, jo Sprinting Speed badhaati hai. lagaataara Sprint karane ke baada Deadly Velocity activate hoti hai aur isaki active window men target ko hit karane vaali pahali Shot ko extra Damage milataa hai.
currentEn: Sprinting speed increases by 6%. Sprint continuously for 4 seconds to activate Deadly Velocity. The effect lasts 5 seconds; the first shot that hits a target during this window deals 106% damage.
currentHi: Sprinting Speed 6% badha jaati hai. Deadly Velocity activate karane ke lie 4 seconds lagaataara Sprint karen. Effect 5 seconds taka rahataa hai; isa Window ke dauraana target ko hit karane vaali pahali Shot 106% Damage deti hai.

rows.value: First 1 shot that hits a target
Not listed on the official profile

notesEn: The official character page specifies the sprint trigger, 5-second active window and 106% damage on the first shot that hits a target.
The profile does not publish a separate cooldown value.
OB47's awakening-system change replaced non-awakened skills with their awakened versions for all players; both character appearances remained selectable.
Garena's official localized Kelly profile also lists a 6% sprint-speed increase alongside Deadly Velocity.
notesHi: Official Character Page Sprint Trigger, 5-second Active Window aur target ko hit karane vaali pahali Shot para 106% Damage ki pushti karataa hai.
Profile men alaga Cooldown Value publish nahin ki gai hai.
OB47 ke Awakening-system badalaava men sabhi players ke lie non-awakened Skills ki jagaha awakened versions ne le li; donon Character Appearances aba bhi selectable hain.
Garena ki official localized Kelly Profile men Deadly Velocity ke saatha 6% Sprinting Speed Increase bhi di gai hai.
historyEn: 2018: Kelly introduced with Dash.
